The new setter breaks case-insensitive storage for mixed-case keys and should be corrected before merge.

## Critical

## Important
- app/cache.py:27 — correctness — Calling `set("ALPHA", 1)` stores the original key, but `get("ALPHA")` looks up `"alpha"` and returns `None`. Normalize the key with `key.lower()` when storing it, and cover mixed-case insertion in the round-trip test. — Mixed-case writes cannot be retrieved and overwrite attempts can leave stale lowercase values visible.
